confidence_notes: Restaurant and coffee anchors rest on several aggregator and menu snippets, many dated 2024 to 2026 and mixed between town and beach-zone venues; anchors reflect a town-centre mix, not beach clubs. Peso figures were converted at about 17.5 MXN per USD, based on a snippet showing Mex$53 = $3.02, not a verified current rate. Cocktail and wine figures come from a single nightlife blog and older menus, so they are less certain. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and the city context; no booking pages or current listings were inspected. The FX value 0.6720 for 18 Nov 2026 came from search-result snippets (an aggregator page and a reference to the RBA RSS feed); the rba.gov.au table itself was not opened, so verify it there.
comparable_city_reasoning: Mexican Caribbean resort-town basis: Tulum town prices for local and mid-range restaurants, with bar and café prices from Tulum-specific menus and aggregators. Beach-zone premiums are not included. No separate comparable city was used.
